visualCharacteristics.purpose: Expandable tip panels shown as separate white shadowed cards, each title optionally led by an icon and followed by a chevron; first item open
visualCharacteristics.summary: Separate white panels with a 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.1) shadow and ~20px gaps, on a light-grey section band. Title row ~61px tall: optional red line icon on the left, 16px/700 #535353 label, chevron on the right (down when closed, up when open). Body: left-aligned bold sub-heading paragraphs, paragraphs and bulleted lists. The first item is open on load. On the source the icons are CSS-drawn; here they are an optional per-item image and the title renders without an icon when it is not set.

contentPattern.structure: One row per item with cells: label (UE field summary), body rich text (field text), then an optional icon image (fields image + imageAlt). Rows with only label and body render without an icon

cells: Label text (field summary), e.g. Your identity
Optional icon image (field image, alt in imageAlt)

usage: Security page: four security tip panels (Your identity, Your computer, Your smartphone, Your business) under the "Things you can do to protect yourself" heading in a light-grey section.
reuseGuidance: Use for FAQ or tip lists that should look like separate shadowed cards rather than a bordered list. Put the label in the first cell and the answer in the second; add an icon image in the third cell (UE Icon field) to show it before the title. The first item always opens on load. For a plain bordered accordion use the base accordion block.
